subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should ClawHub accept package release changelog auto-preview for authorized package owners, publisher members, moderators, and admins, including use of prior release README content for preview generation?
rationale: Code review can verify the access gate, but a non-maintainer PR is adding a new public action that reads package release storage and may call OpenAI, which is a product/security boundary choice.

options.title: Accept gated auto-preview
options.body: Land the owner/publisher/staff-gated preview path after rebasing and fixing the package README prompt label.

options.title: Narrow the access contract
options.body: Require a stricter manage-only role or explicit maintainer-approved policy before prior release storage can feed preview generation.

options.title: Keep changelogs manual-only
options.body: Pause or close this PR if automatic plugin release changelog previews are not desired.

recommendation.title: Accept gated auto-preview
recommendation.body: Land the owner/publisher/staff-gated preview path after rebasing and fixing the package README prompt label.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main history on the package publish/security boundary and is already requested for review on the live PR.
